summary: Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (test_mindpulse_api.py). Frontend E2E: assessment wizard 7-step flow verified — HIGH scores (30/20/34) → 'Severe Stress', LOW scores (4/3/5) → 'Healthy', demo data (26/17/28) → 'Moderate Stress' at 70.48% confidence. Bug 'inaccurate results' is fixed — the deployed full model reacts correctly to self-report scores. Model Performance page had a runtime crash (ReferenceError: comparison is not defined) which I patched by adding the missing destructuring for `comparison` and `baseline` from metrics. After fix: 5 comparison rows render, 1 deployed row highlighted, baseline-note present. Explainability, History (55 rows), Overview all load without runtime errors. Responsive @390px OK (no horizontal scroll on Performance and Assessment). Backend insights include sensors-only comparison text, baseline_comparison object present with model 'sensors-only neural network'.

ui_bugs.issue: Was crashing with 'ReferenceError: comparison is not defined' — variables `comparison` and `baseline` were referenced in JSX but never destructured from `metrics`. FIXED by testing agent (added: const comparison = metrics?.model_comparison || []; const baseline = metrics?.baseline_sensors_only;).

action_items: No open critical action items. Verify the Performance page fix (comparison/baseline destructuring in App.js line ~44) is acceptable — the fix is one line and preserves the intended UI.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single very large file with dense one-line function components — extremely hard to maintain; recommend splitting each page into its own file.
Missing variables (comparison, baseline) not caught earlier suggests no lint/typecheck in CI. Consider adding eslint no-undef enforcement.
assessments.history endpoint currently returns 55 rows — consider server-side pagination if history grows further.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None; ran 3 assessments through UI (demo, HIGH, LOW) which were persisted to history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug reported by the user ('inaccurate results') is fully fixed: deployed 'full' variant NN correctly maps self-report sliders → class. Backend pytest is the regression suite. If Performance page crashes again, check that `comparison` and `baseline` are still destructured from metrics in App.js Performance().
rca of the issue: Performance page runtime crash RCA: JSX at Performance() referenced two local variables (`comparison`, `baseline`) but the destructuring line only defined `classification`, `regression`, `matrix`. Any user navigating to /performance saw a full-screen error overlay. Fix: add `const comparison = metrics?.model_comparison || []; const baseline = metrics?.baseline_sensors_only;` next to existing destructuring. Verified in browser — comparison table renders 5 rows with the deployed row highlighted, baseline-note visible.
